description: Four-band equaliser — a low shelf, two parametric bands and a high shelf — with the high-pass, band-pass and low-pass taps of both parametric filters brought out separately

params.text: Sets the corner frequency of the high shelf, 20Hz to 20kHz, above which the shelf gain applies
Boosts or cuts everything above the high shelf's corner frequency by up to 18dB, flat at the centre, not the 15dB the manual gives
Sets the centre frequency of the first parametric band, 20Hz to 20kHz
Boosts or cuts the first parametric band by up to 18dB, flat at the centre, not the 15dB the manual gives
Sets how narrow the first parametric band is, a Q of 0.5 to 40
Sets the centre frequency of the second parametric band, 20Hz to 20kHz
Boosts or cuts the second parametric band by up to 18dB, flat at the centre, not the 15dB the manual gives
Sets how narrow the second parametric band is, a Q of 0.5 to 40
Sets the corner frequency of the low shelf, 20Hz to 20kHz, below which the shelf gain applies
Boosts or cuts everything below the low shelf's corner frequency by up to 18dB, flat at the centre, not the 15dB the manual gives

inputs.text: Shifts the high shelf's corner frequency, one volt per octave
Adds to the high shelf's gain, 3dB per volt
Shifts the first parametric band's centre frequency, one volt per octave
Adds to the first parametric band's gain, 3dB per volt
Narrows or widens the first parametric band, and can push the Q well past the knob's range
Shifts the second parametric band's centre frequency, one volt per octave
Adds to the second parametric band's gain, 3dB per volt
Narrows or widens the second parametric band, and can push the Q well past the knob's range
Shifts the low shelf's corner frequency, one volt per octave
Adds to the low shelf's gain, 3dB per volt
Shifts the frequency of all four bands at once, one volt per octave
Adds to the gain of all four bands at once, 3dB per volt

outputs.text: The high-pass tap of the first parametric filter
The band-pass tap of the first parametric filter
The low-pass tap of the first parametric filter
The high-pass tap of the second parametric filter
The band-pass tap of the second parametric filter
The low-pass tap of the second parametric filter
The audio with all four bands applied; the red lamp beside it lights when the signal clips

notes: the number of channels on the audio input sets how many the module filters, up to sixteen, and every output carries that many.
menu: Pad input by -6dB — halves the level going into the equaliser, which leaves room for large boosts
